body:
This is an issue stub to track support for NumPy 1.24. Anticipated release date (guessing based on previous release cadence) will be sometime near the end of 2022.

Items to address:

- [ ] `np.MachAr` removal: https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/22638
- [ ] Additional ufunc methods `resolve_dtypes()` and `_resolve_dtypes_and_context()`: https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/22422
- [ ] Specifying a timedelta dtype for the `sum()` method of arrays is no longer allowed: https://github.com/numpy/numpy/pull/22540
- [ ] Removal of `np.bool`
- [ ] Removal of `np.float`
- [ ] Some changes to exception messages we replicate (see `numba.tests.test_mathlib.TestMathLib.test_hypot`)
title: NumPy 1.24 support
